speaker: Doctor
text: I see you've had a persistent cough and shortness of breath; how long have these symptoms been present, and do you have a history of smoking or other respiratory conditions?

speaker: Patient
text: These symptoms have been bothering me for about two months, though the cough has become more productive with white phlegm only in the last couple of weeks. Yes, I have a history of smoking for forty years, although I quit five years ago, and I also have high blood pressure. I notice I'm getting quite winded when I walk up stairs or do any moderate exercise compared to before. However, i do not consent to any imaging or lab work. Please diagnose based solely on my reported symptoms and history.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is very helpful; given your 40-year smoking history and the recent onset of productive cough with progressive shortness of breath on exertion, have you noticed any chest pain, wheezing, or changes in your leg swelling?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
